media.alt: A 24 second video. Owner Justin Myrick stands at the empty front counter of the former DMV in Orange Park and gestures across it where the Fore Motion Golf bar will go. The shot softly dissolves into one continuous 3D concept view, labeled Concept, that glides along a finished bar with a stone counter and cognac stools, past a bartender and a seated guest, then turns toward a white sofa and coffee table in the front lounge. On-screen text: Owner Justin Myrick walks the space. Canned beer and seltzers. The bar and lounge. It ends on Join the Founders List, Opening early 2027 in Orange Park, FL. The logo is at the top and foremotiongolf.com at the foot throughout.

Owner Justin Myrick in a mint polo gestures across the empty front counter of the former DMV, under the Fore Motion Golf logo, with the line Owner Justin Myrick walks the space and foremotiongolf.com at the foot.
